en.title: Number to Words Converter — Coding.Tools
en.description: Convert numbers to English words, ordinals, and ordinal numbers instantly.
en.toolDescription: Convert integers to English words, ordinal words, and ordinal numbers.
descParas: This tool converts any integer into its English word representation, ordinal word, and ordinal number format. It is useful for writing checks, generating human-readable reports, creating educational materials, or formatting numbers in legal documents.
The conversion runs locally in your browser using the number-to-words library. The number you enter is not uploaded, stored, or sent to a server.
steps: Type or paste a number into the input field.
Click Convert or simply type to see live results.
Three results are displayed: the word form (e.g. "forty-two"), the ordinal word (e.g. "forty-second"), and the ordinal number (e.g. "42nd").
Use Copy to copy the word result to the clipboard, or Clear to reset.
en.whatIs: What is number to words conversion?
whatIsParas: Number to words conversion transforms a numeric value into its spelled-out English form. The ordinal form adds the appropriate suffix (st, nd, rd, th) to describe position or order in a sequence. This is commonly used in financial documents, legal writing, and formal correspondence.
en.inputNotesPara: The tool accepts integers, including negative numbers and zero. Very large numbers (billions and above) are supported. Decimal numbers are not supported — only whole integers can be converted to words.
en.examplePara: See how different numbers convert to words:
en.exampleCode:
--- Number: 42 ---
Word: forty-two
Ordinal Word: forty-second
Ordinal Number: 42nd

--- Number: 1000000 ---
Word: one million
Ordinal Word: one millionth
Ordinal Number: 1000000th

--- Number: -7 ---
Word: negative seven
Ordinal Word: negative seventh
Ordinal Number: -7th

cn.title: 数字转英文 — Coding.Tools
cn.description: 即时将数字转换为英文单词、序数词和序数。
cn.toolDescription: 将整数转换为英文单词、序数词和序数。
descParas: 此工具将任何整数转换为其英文单词表示、序数词和序数格式。它适用于写支票、生成可读报告、创建教育材料或在法律文件中格式化数字。
转换在浏览器中使用 number-to-words 库本地运行。您输入的数字不会被上传、存储或发送到服务器。
steps: 在输入字段中输入或粘贴数字。
点击转换或直接输入查看实时结果。
显示三个结果：单词形式（如 "forty-two"）、序数词（如 "forty-second"）和序数（如 "42nd"）。
使用复制将单词结果复制到剪贴板，或清除重置。
whatIsParas: 数字转英文是将数值转换为英文拼写形式的过程。序数形式添加适当的后缀（st、nd、rd、th）来描述序列中的位置或顺序。这通常用于财务文件、法律写作和正式信函。
cn.inputNotesPara: 该工具接受整数，包括负数和零。支持非常大的数字（十亿及以上）。不支持小数数字——只有整数可以转换为单词。
cn.examplePara: 查看不同数字如何转换为单词：
cn.exampleCode:
--- Number: 42 ---
Word: forty-two
Ordinal Word: forty-second
Ordinal Number: 42nd

--- Number: 1000000 ---
Word: one million
Ordinal Word: one millionth
Ordinal Number: 1000000th

--- Number: -7 ---
Word: negative seven
Ordinal Word: negative seventh
Ordinal Number: -7th

jp.title: 数字を英語に — Coding.Tools
jp.description: 数字を英単語、序数語、序数に即座に変換。
jp.toolDescription: 整数を英単語、序数語、序数に変換。
descParas: このツールは任意の整数を英単語、序数語、序数形式に変換します。小切手の作成、レポート作成、教材作成、法的文書の数字フォーマットに便利です。
変換はブラウザ内でnumber-to-wordsライブラリを使用してローカルに実行されます。
steps: 入力欄に数字を入力または貼り付けます。
変換をクリックするか、入力すると即座に結果が表示されます。
3つの結果が表示されます：単語形式、序数語、序数。

whatIsParas: 数字を英語への変換は、数値を英語の綴りに変換する処理です。序数形は適切な接尾辞を追加して順序を表します。
jp.inputNotesPara: 負の数とゼロを含む整数を受け付けます。非常に大きな数字にも対応。小数はサポートされていません。

Ordinal Number: 42nd

--- Number: 1000000 ---
Word: one million
Ordinal Word: one millionth
Ordinal Number: 1000000th

--- Number: -7 ---

Ordinal Word: negative seventh
Ordinal Number: -7th

steps: 입력란에 숫자를 입력하거나 붙여넣으세요.
변환을 클릭하거나 입력하면 실시간 결과가 표시됩니다.
세 가지 결과가 표시됩니다: 단어 형태, 서수어, 서수.

kr.inputNotesPara: 음수와 0을 포함한 정수를 허용합니다. 매우 큰 숫자도 지원됩니다. 소수는 지원되지 않습니다.
